newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 18,500 slaughter steers and 13,600 heifers; 51,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 3,400 head previously contracted to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 70.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 68.00-70.00. Pen Utility and Choice 2-4 1100 lbs including heiferettes 65.00.
Wk to Date - 51,300 Week Ago - 13,100 Year Ago - 63,600
